title: The Pidgin Strike
logline: Agricultural loaders develop a composite trade dialect combining five provincial lingos to coordinate an unrecorded freight slowdown, prompting a desperate terminal director to bring in unilingual strikebreakers.

roles.description: Runs the orbital agricultural transfer terminal; panicked by missed shipping quotas and baffled by docker patois.
Head of the cargo loader collective; conducts shift meetings entirely in a rich, multi-origin creole dialect.
A disgraced former phonetician who codified the dockers' slang into an unhackable logistical shorthand.
A chartered bulk transport carrying contract labourers hired to replace the dialect-speaking crews.
The refrigerated staging ring where perishable vegetable cargo is palletized and loaded.
The executive suite overlooking the berths where shipping executives negotiate export tariffs.

public_situation: Perishable food crates spoil on the docks of {role:hydroponic_freight_ring} as loading crews communicate via a confusing hybrid dialect.
private_truth: {role:linguist_smuggler} developed the pidgin for {role:loader_steward} to disguise organized work stoppages from automated corporate acoustic surveillance.

beats.public_change: The terminal management issues mandatory algorithmic translation headsets to all deck crew.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to deliver a shipment of encrypted translation firmware chips directly to the gantry supervisor.
missions.private_fact: He secretly docked loader pay by forty percent last month to offset shipping insurance increases.

beats.public_change: Headsets across the gantry emit nonsensical rhymes as loading speeds drop by half.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to analyze the audio feedback loop on the gantry repeaters to identify whoever uploaded the corrupting linguistic patch.
missions.private_fact: His corporate superiors have warned him that one more day of spoiled produce will void his franchise licence.

beats.public_change: {role:strikebreaker_transport} arrives at the perimeter buoy carrying replacement workers.

missions.reason: The steward contracts the pilot to buzz the incoming transport and jam its docking approaches until the director agrees to talk.
missions.private_fact: The transport captain hails mid-approach offering to turn the ship back if the pilot helps them claim their full breach-of-contract cancellation fee.

player_choice.prompt: The strikebreakers agree to withdraw if paid. The pilot can broker a wage agreement, license the pidgin to an outside freight line, or enforce corporate discipline.

options.label: Force the director to sign the loaders' revised contract and recognize their shop dialect
Sell the pidgin grammar to an independent shipping cartel as a proprietary encryption system

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot blocks the strikebreakers and compels the director to negotiate with the loaders.
resolutions.summary: {role:terminal_director} capitulates, signing wage increases for {role:loader_steward} and acknowledging the dock pidgin as an official trade tongue.

consequences.public_summary: Freight loaders spoke in their own tongue until the terminal gave in and signed their wage hike.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot auctions the codified pidgin dictionary to private shipping brokers.
resolutions.summary: A rival freight cartel buys the dialect for secure channel routing. {role:linguist_smuggler} profits, while {role:loader_steward} loses operational secrecy.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot turned a dockworker dialect into a corporate cipher, making the linguist rich while the strike unraveled.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot forces the strikebreaker transport through and breaks the gantry boycott.
resolutions.summary: {role:strikebreaker_transport} docks, replacing the loader workforce. {role:loader_steward} is blacklisted, and automated headsets are made compulsory.

consequences.public_summary: An armed escort cleared the way for replacement loaders, breaking the dialect strike at the produce docks.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes no contracts or negotiations completely stall.
resolutions.summary: Tons of produce rot on the gantries as neither side yields. {role:terminal_director} faces insolvency, and regional markets suffer severe fresh-ration shortages.

loose_threads.detail: The linguist's encrypted data crystals carry escrow metadata linking royalties to an off-world hauler trust.
Berth bookings for the strikebreaker transport were filed ten days before the wage slowdown began.
The management translation firmware authorization key is registered under an executive identity that does not appear in station staff logs.

radio_hooks: Produce shipments stalled across {system} as terminal management clashes with multilingual freight loaders.
{role:administrative_spire} warns that unauthorized acoustic dialects will be treated as contractual sabotage.
Gantry workers hold sing-song rallies outside refrigeration bays, demanding fair wage calculations.

voice_direction.terminal_director: Pompous and high-strung, speaking in elongated formal sentences and complaining about vulgar vernaculars. Refuses to acknowledge dock idioms.
voice_direction.loader_steward: Warm, melodic cadence, switching rapidly between loanwords and sharp common idioms. Uses colourful metaphors and never speaks standard dock terminology.
voice_direction.linguist_smuggler: Cynical, wry, pedantic academic tone peppered with smuggler slang. Delights in explaining syntactic irregularities to confused pilots.
